title: Home to Lagos and a 25-Month Wait: How Tayo Oviosu Started Paga
conflicts: Launch date: Stanford GSB (Jan 2012) says Paga opened in early 2011 and had over 42,000 customers by the end of 2011; Oviosu (BusinessDay, 2019) says the licence took 25 months, the Series A seven more, and services went to market in August 2012. Both are given, each attributed. User and agent counts vary by year (8.2m users in 2018, 12m+ customers in 2019, 19m registered in 2023); only dated 2011 and 2019 figures are used.
notes: Slate framing corrected: he left Cisco in 2008 for a private equity job in Lagos (about five months at Travant) and founded Paga in April 2009. Quote stance 'complicates'. TechCabal, Guardian Nigeria, Techpoint and Paga's Medium history could not be read and are not cited.
